verdict.rationale: Inngest documents built-in metrics, traces, and per-step timing for every run without instrumentation, and offers a REST API and CLI for pulling run and trace data programmatically. There is no evidence of exporting failure rates, latencies, or queue depths to an external observability stack, and none of alerting. missing for 10: export to external observability tools (e.g. OTel/Prometheus/Datadog), queue-depth metrics, alerting on workflow misbehavior, independent corroboration.
